This is an appeal U/Sec. 29 of the Protection Protection of Woman from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 (hereinafter referred to as 'DV Act') against the order dated 03.10.2023 (hereinafter referred to as 'impugned order') passed by Ld. Metropolitan Magistrate (hereinafter referred to as Ld. M.M.) in CT Case No. 1059/2022 titled as "Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh" whereby Ld. Trial Court has passed order that respondent no. 1 shall continue to pay the educational/ school fee of minor children by depositing the same directly to the school and also directed to pay Rs. 90,000/- for the maintenance of the complainant as well as minor children from the date of filing of the Aradhana Srivastava vs Vivek Virendra Singh on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40890879/ 1 petition i.e. 06.06.2022 till the disposal of the case on merits, to the complainant. 2.

Respondent no. 1 is a womanizer and after marriage has been number of extra marital affairs. Respondent no. 1 got into an extra marital affair while the appellant was pregnant in the year 2016.
